retrieval_flow: GET https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/progress/<snapshot_id> until its status reads 'ready' (or 'failed'), then GET https://api.brightdata.com/datasets/v3/snapshot/<snapshot_id>?format=json for the records. The snapshot id is persisted in the ledger BEFORE the first poll, so a later run resumes THIS job: re-running this module with the same --security-key/--as-of polls and retrieves it and submits NO new discovery (the brief: do not resubmit discovery on every polling cycle).
